title: Disputing Souchon's claims of hearing Joe Oliver on Basin Street
summary: He says no music like that was on Basin Street and goes on to complain about police, discipline and juvenile delinquency.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Aided in a better by no other than Dr. Sushant, who puts himself as a jazz historian. Now this man here, as a jazz historian, never played jazz. He says he used to sit across the road from on Basin Street and listen to Joe Oliver playing music. And there's where he got his idea from. Well now the only thing he could have heard on Basin Street, and there's many more men as old as I am, can tell you they had no music on Basin Street outside a little violin or a piano. Or they had three Negro Rhymers at Anderson's. But Joe Oliver, you couldn't hear him on Basin Street. The only thing he could have been counting was the customers who went into Lula White's or Josie Arlington's. And that's all. And he says he went over to get a beer and some of his articles. Well I can tell you this. New Orleans was a place less than 285,000 people. There wasn't a police that wasn't on every block, that knew every strange face that come into the district. He'd have had his tail whipped with the strap because they don't play with them like they play with them today. They played with them as gentlemen. Them police worked on you. You were bad, they made you good. There was no two ways about it. And you could tell your daddy when you went home you got another beating too. But today the daddy wants you to put police in jail for whipping a bad boy. That's why you have so much damn juvenile delinquency and all other stuff around this country. Through propaganda. Through lies that's been spread around. You don't know what to believe anymore. But getting back to the jazz club these people formed a racket. Marshall Stern founded a good racket. He got any milk. The Guggenheimer Foundation on it. Got a lot of money. I don't know whether he divided it up with Dr. Sushon or not. But up to that time Dr. Sushon was with me. You got his letter to Lane. He says notwithstanding he says the original Dix-Lane jazz band started the whole thing. Today I didn't start anything. I was nowhere around. He was around with his six and seven eight band. They make me laugh sometime. To get on here with his colored funerals. I feel sorry for colored man. I say give him what any white man deserves. A good living. A good job. Good education. But when it comes to integration. They may be hard on me on this. But I say I draw the line. Because he hasn't earned that in their morals. Now they have some good colored people. They don't suffer. They're allowed to make a good living. As any white man. As people run insurance companies. As the Gieders. And Moss. And other people. Who set themselves up in business. I had many colored people work with me. And they used to bring up this subject. I said now what stopped you from building a hotel for colored people. As well as a white man building a hotel for white men. Why do you want an extra to a white man? Well it says that's equality. No that ain't equality. I say. Do you think it's equality that I can't go down in one of these big clubs? I'm a white man. I'm bored from their clubs. I can't get in their clubs. That's segregation against me. I don't have no scruples against that. First place I don't have the money. Next place I don't belong in there. I'm a poor man. They're rich men. And when the colored man says he's the same as the white man. I say it's wrong. Because when I read a lot of these guys. And they went track back to Europe. To Africa. All they found. Yes they found where white men were. That they had some of them were smart. And just like a beggar. When you put them on a horse. They want to ride them to death. But I say the NACP is riding to a great big fall. And it ain't going to be long either. Because they will never get integration. The way they want it. They want white skin. They don't want equality. They want to marry. With white people. Now. That's allowed to be done. I feel sorry for the Anglo-Saxon people. And the European white people. What you call the Caucasian race. Because two thirds of the world. Are yellow and black. You won't have no white race. I was once told by a doctor. He said Mr. La Rocca. You're a holler at that colored man. He says you'll save yourself. You're going to get heart trouble. He says you've got a million years of learning you. This Negro has 150 years of education behind him. How can a brain compete with a man. That has millions of years. Of cultivation of ideas. And this colored man just has in the last 150 years. A little education that he has acquired from the white man. Compete with him. Yes there's plenty of smart colored men. But I haven't seen no Enrico Fermi. I haven't seen no Einstein with him. I ain't seen no Columbus. Not coming out of Africa. And if you want to know the truth about her. I ain't never been to Africa. They don't have no jazz music there either. They don't have no Dixieland music. They never had no instruments there either. And they don't even know where the wheel is. They're so damn lazy. All they do is lay down and let the women work for them. And when they come over here. That's what they expect to do. Get the women to work for them. And that's what they do here. Their women work for them. Can I put something else on there? I'm going out of line now.
